title: Fiber-based flexible magneto-mechano-electric generators enhanced by UV and IR treatments for sustainable IoT sensors
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00137D, Paper
Nayak Ram, Karthik Vaduganathan, Annapureddy Venkateswarlu
A magneto-mechano-electric (MME) energy harvester optimized for IoT by capturing energy from low-amplitude magnetic fields. UV-treated piezoelectric fibers and IR-treated Metglas improve performance, generating 1.4 mW cm−3 under a 6 Oe, 50 Hz field.
